name: Andover Summer Session
description_short: A five-week academic summer program at Phillips Academy in Andover, Massachusetts, for students entering grades 7–12. Students can board or attend as day students. The Lower School Institute (grades 7–8) studies several subjects under one theme, and Upper School students (grades 9–12) choose from more than 70 courses.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page gives two different opening dates for the 2027 application: 'will open in November' near the top and 'will open in early December' in the FAQ. Admission is rolling and usually fills by mid-March.
Ages are approximate on the page ('~12-14', '~14-17'). Eligibility is based on the grade the student is entering.
The statistics on this page (590 boarding, 72 day students) are for 2026, but the 2027 dates are confirmed.
Financial aid is limited. It mainly goes to families working with program partners. International students, independent-school students and returning students are not eligible.

refund_policy_summary: A non-refundable deposit of 20% of tuition is due within two weeks of acceptance; the balance is due by May 1, 2027. 50% of paid tuition is refunded for withdrawal on or before June 15, 2027, 25% between June 16 and June 30, 2027, and none after that or on dismissal.
